paragraphs: R' Chananiah, colleague of the Rabbis. See the entry Rav Chananiah, marker כ).[^1][^2]

notes.text: כ) is retained as Hyman’s entry marker, without assigning a modern number or target identity.
חברון דרבנן is read as “colleague of the Rabbis,” rather than the place Hebron. The heading’s ר׳ remains R'; the target explicitly writes רב, Rav.
